event.title: Xenia Voigt Viking Quest Fall Festival
event.venue: Xenia Voigt Arts Integration Academy, 1201 Cushing Drive, Round Rock, TX 78664

confirmed.title: Current vendor plan
confirmed.detail: K&K BBQ is the savory vendor, Hearth & Honey is the sweet vendor, and Pour The Fun is the beverage add-on. The PTA board waived the 10% fee. Participation approval only; no vendor contracts or agreements will be sent.

confirmed.title: Major attractions
confirmed.detail: AiRCO Mechanical is sponsoring the trackless train and Shine Pediatric Dental Co. is sponsoring the combo inflatable. The sponsors will pay the attraction providers directly so the PTA does not have to front the cost and each sponsor can document its charitable contribution. No extra inflatables are part of the current plan.

confirmed.title: Teacher-trunk candy
confirmed.detail: A+ Federal Credit Union pledged 12 extra-large Costco candy variety bags at 5.75 lb each (69 lb total) for seven teacher trunks, one per grade Pre-K through 5. This is projected to cover the teacher trunks; verify the actual piece count when received. Community trunk hosts provide their own candy.

confirmed.title: Activities and Viking stations
confirmed.detail: The plan includes carnival games, activities, and five Viking stations: Pumpkin Bowling, Apple Scoop Challenge, Fall Sensory Mystery, Collaborative Autumn Mural, and Gratitude Tree. All 80 apples are covered.

confirmed.title: Sensory-friendly retreat
confirmed.detail: The retreat will be in the Boys & Girls Club portable. No PTA materials are needed; only campus coordination and signage remain.

confirmed.title: Silent auction setup
confirmed.detail: Seven silent-auction prizes are currently confirmed. Prizes will be displayed on the cafeteria stage, with school tables in front and bid sheets arranged in stacked rows.

confirmed.title: Face painting
confirmed.detail: Face painting will be handled by volunteers; no paid face-painting vendor is needed.

confirmed.title: Event audio
confirmed.detail: There will be no DJ. The event will use the school sound system; Brittani's phone will be used for Cake Walk music playback.

confirmed.title: Cleanup and safety supplies
confirmed.detail: Express Commercial Cleaning committed the listed mop, broom, disinfectant, liners, paper towels, floor cleaner, gloves, and hand-sanitizer supplies.

confirmed.title: School equipment
confirmed.detail: The school/PE inventory includes numbered floor spots, cones/markers, bean bags, balls, hoops, jump ropes, pool noodles, buckets, ropes, sacks, balance/obstacle equipment, hippity hops, plastic pools, and display tables. The final activity pull list is still required.

confirmed.title: Garage Band
confirmed.detail: Voigt Garage Band confirmed one song, up to 5 minutes, on the cafeteria stage. Final timing and school-audio setup are pending.

confirmed.title: School website PTA link
confirmed.detail: The school website should link to the existing public PTA domain xeniavoigtpta.org, not the blank Google Site.

pending.title: Campus approvals and safety layout
pending.detail: Written school approval is still needed for vendor and activity locations, train/inflatable placement, emergency clearances, traffic flow, ADA routes, room/field use, and campus access.

pending.title: Vendor operations

pending.detail: 15 Nothing Bundt Cakes Bundtlets and one Paige's Bakehouse cookie bundle are committed, but additional donated cake/treat prizes are still needed. Continue sourcing donations so the PTA does not have to spend cash unnecessarily.

pending.title: Volunteer coverage
